prompts.intent: Infer only the most common aliases that another agent may use for the identifier portion of an existing namespace object, excluding the canonical identifier itself and excluding variants.

variables.name: name
variables.description: Human-readable name of the existing object.

variables.name: identifier
variables.description: Canonical identifier whose aliases are being inferred.

variables.name: prefix
variables.description: Namespace prefix that precedes the identifier.

output_contract.description: Return a JSON array containing strings and no surrounding prose.
presentation_constraints: Do not wrap the response in a Markdown code fence.

behavioral_requirements.text: Include only the most common aliases.
Do not return variants as aliases.
Exclude the canonical identifier value supplied by {identifier}.

revisions.prompt_template: In our knowledge graph there is an object for "{name}" described as "{description}" that is currently referenced in the namespace as "{namespace}". As an agent, infer only the most common aliases for "{identifier}" without variants that other agents will use to match this object for the text following "{prefix}.". Output: string[] only while excluding "{identifier}".
